findings.detail: 4 failing tests in packages/prediction-engine, 3 distinct causes:
causes: a) falsify.ts imports ../bernoulli-eprocess.js but the module exists only at packages/prediction-engine/attic/bernoulli-eprocess.ts (archived). The whole file fails to load -> falsify.test.ts errored. Import path needs pointing at the live copy, or the file restored from attic.

b) yacoe-backtest-fast-slice.test.ts opens data/nflverse/ngs_receiving_2021_2025_harness_rows.json which does not exist anywhere on this checkout (data/nflverse/ is empty). Fixture missing -> fail-closed test.

c) route-run-red-cand-001.test.ts is an INTENTIONAL RED test (asserts method_tag equals 'unexpected_red_tag_for_cand_001' and expects false to be true). 2 of the 4 failures are correct-by-design RED, not breakage; the suite name says so.

d) metric-source-payload-rights.test.ts expects fixture ids to equal the canonical web registry ids: [18 ids] vs [17 ids]. The web registry gained a source the fixture registry does not list (or vice versa) - a genuine drift, one id wide.
findings.recommendation: fix a) (import path / restore from attic), b) (restore the harness fixture or mark the test skip-if-absent), d) (align the two registries). Leave c) RED by design. Then the package is 7,180/7,180 minus known-red.
